display.purpose: Page-level task statements and key flow headings.

body.purpose: Instructions, request context, and progress copy.

label.purpose: Form labels and compact navigation copy.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Selection, hover, and focus feedback with an already-visible default state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action for submission, tracking, and saving.

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Visible-label text entry with phone-ready target size.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:10px;color:oklch(0.22 0.025 255);font:500 14px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:48px;border:1px solid oklch(0.8 0.02 250);border-radius:12px;background:oklch(0.975 0.006 250);padding:0 12px;color:inherit;font:400 16px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid oklch(0.64 0.15 250 / .35);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Segmented Navigation
components.description: Compact two-view requester navigation that remains legible on phone widths; the authenticated dashboard is outside this navigation.

components.name: Request Ledger Row
components.description: Full-width request-type choice with a brief committed-state response.
components.css: .ds-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:start;width:100%;padding:20px 4px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid oklch(0.87 0.015 250);background:transparent;color:oklch(0.22 0.025 255);text-align:left}.ds-row::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:16px auto 16px 0;width:1px;background:oklch(0.28 0.055 258);transform:scaleY(0);transition:transform 200ms ease-out}.ds-row.is-selected{background:oklch(0.94 0.018 250 / .8)}.ds-row.is-selected::before{transform:scaleY(1)}.ds-row i{font-style:normal;transition:transform 200ms ease-out}.ds-row.is-selected i{transform:translateX(2px)}

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact status marker; use the primary fill only for active work.

narrative.overview: Internal Request Hub makes a handoff feel clear and accountable instead of bureaucratic. Cool paper-white surfaces, navy ink, restrained cobalt response, and thin ledger dividers make the screen calm enough for routine internal work while keeping the next action obvious.
keyCharacteristics: Divider-led composition instead of repeated feature cards.
One primary navy action per local task.
Generous reading space around form fields and request rows.
Short state transitions that support, never delay, task completion.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt communicates focus or a committed choice; it is not a decorative fill scattered across a screen.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used only for ticket IDs and numerical monitoring values, where tabular clarity is functional.

rules.name: The Ledger Depth Rule
rules.body: Do not combine a heavy border with a broad shadow on the same surface. A surface chooses one structural cue.

dos: Do keep visible labels, nearby help, and field-level errors for requester forms.
Do use a vertical request sequence on phones and preserve every core requester action.
Do reserve the navy/cobalt range for primary actions, focus, and committed states.
donts: Don't turn the request-type flow into equal icon cards or a marketing-style hero.
Don't make touch actions depend on hover or use requester controls below 44px.
Don't expose technical classification in requester-facing views.
